description: This file defines an interface IRelationalStorage for relational database operations, including asynchronous read and execute methods, along with properties for database invariants and connection strings.

classes.name: IRelationalStorage
classes.description: An interface defining methods for executing queries asynchronously and retrieving data from a relational database, with properties indicating database type and connection details.

methods.name: ReadAsync<TResult>
methods.description: Asynchronously executes a SELECT statement and maps the results to a list of specified type using a selector function.

methods.name: ExecuteAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously executes a non-query SQL command, such as INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, or DDL, returning the number of affected rows.
